actions.createRecord.description: Creates a new record in a collection
actions.createRecord.props.collection.de: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.createRecord.props.fields.descri: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name
actions.createRecord.props.recordData.de: JSON object with the fields to create. E.g.: { "title": "test", "score": 123 }
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.deleteRecord.description: Deletes a single record from a collection
actions.deleteRecord.props.collection.de: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.deleteRecord.props.recordId.desc: ID of the record to delete
actions.getFullList.description: Gets all the data for a given collection
actions.getFullList.props.collection.des: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.getFullList.props.fields.descrip: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name
actions.getFullList.props.sort.descripti: Order attribute(s). Use - for DESC, + for ASC. E.g.: -created,id
actions.getList.description: Gets a paginated list of records from a collection
actions.getList.props.collection.descrip: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.getList.props.fields.description: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name
actions.getList.props.page.description: The page (offset) of the paginated list (default: 1)
actions.getList.props.skipTotal.descript: Skip total counts query for faster results (totalItems and totalPages will be -1)
actions.getList.props.sort.description: Order attribute(s). Use - for DESC, + for ASC. E.g.: -created,id
actions.getRecord.description: Gets a single record by ID from a collection
actions.getRecord.props.collection.descr: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.getRecord.props.fields.descripti: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name
actions.getRecord.props.recordId.descrip: ID of the record to view
actions.pocketbase_batch_records.descrip: Runs several record create, update, upsert and delete requests in one transaction.
actions.pocketbase_batch_records.props.r: Array of requests, each { "method": "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE", "url": "/api/collections/<collection>/records[/<id>]", "body": { ...fields } }. PUT on the records URL is an upsert by "id" in the body.
actions.pocketbase_create_backup.descrip: Creates a new backup of the database and files.
actions.pocketbase_create_backup.props.n: Backup file name using only a-z, 0-9, _ and -, ending in .zip, e.g. "before_import.zip". Leave empty for an automatic name.
actions.pocketbase_create_collection.des: Creates a base, auth or view collection.
actions.pocketbase_create_collection.pro: Other collection options sent as-is, e.g. { "indexes": ["CREATE INDEX idx_title ON posts (title)"] } or auth options like passwordAuth and oauth2.

Array of field definitions, e.g. [{ "name": "title", "type": "text", "required": true }, { "name": "views", "type": "number" }]. Types: text, editor, number, bool, email, url, date, autodate, select, file, relation, json, geoPoint, password.
Object with any of listRule, viewRule, createRule, updateRule, deleteRule. A filter string limits access, "" allows everyone, null means superusers only (the default).
base stores records, auth stores users that can sign in, view is a read-only SQL view. Defaults to base.
SQL SELECT for a view collection; must return an "id" column. Required when Type is view.
actions.pocketbase_delete_backup.descrip: Permanently deletes a stored backup file.
actions.pocketbase_delete_backup.props.k: Backup file name to delete. List Backups returns it.
actions.pocketbase_delete_collection.des: Permanently deletes a collection and all its records.
actions.pocketbase_delete_collection.pro: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.pocketbase_download_backup.props: Backup file name, e.g. "pb_backup_20240101.zip". List Backups returns it.
actions.pocketbase_download_file.descrip: Downloads a file stored in a record's file field.
actions.pocketbase_download_file.props.c: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.pocketbase_download_file.props.f: The stored file name exactly as it appears in the record's file field, e.g. "report_52iwbgds7l.pdf".
actions.pocketbase_download_file.props.r: ID of the record that holds the file. Get List returns record IDs.
actions.pocketbase_download_file.props.t: Image thumbnail size such as "100x100" or "0x300"; it must be listed in the file field's thumb sizes. Leave empty for the original file.
actions.pocketbase_get_collection.descri: Gets one collection with its fields, indexes and rules.
Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.pocketbase_get_log.description: Gets one log entry by ID.
actions.pocketbase_get_log.props.logId.d: ID of the log entry. List Logs returns it.
actions.pocketbase_import_collections.de: Creates or replaces collections from a list of collection definitions.
actions.pocketbase_import_collections.pr: Array of full collection definitions, in the same shape List Collections returns.
true deletes every existing collection (and its records) that is not in the list. Defaults to false.
actions.pocketbase_list_auth_methods.des: Lists the sign-in methods enabled for an auth collection.
actions.pocketbase_list_auth_methods.pro: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.pocketbase_list_collections.desc: Lists the collections in the instance with their fields and rules.
actions.pocketbase_list_collections.prop: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
Comma separated fields to sort by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. "-created,name".
actions.pocketbase_list_logs.description: Lists one page of request and app logs.
Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
Comma separated fields to sort by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. "-created,name".
actions.pocketbase_preview_view_query.de: Checks a view collection query and returns the fields and a sample row it would produce.
actions.pocketbase_preview_view_query.pr: SQL SELECT that returns an "id" column, e.g. "SELECT id, title FROM posts".
actions.pocketbase_restore_backup.descri: Replaces the current data with a stored backup and restarts the instance.
Backup file name to restore. List Backups returns it.
Cron job ID, e.g. "__pbLogsCleanup__". List Cron Jobs returns it.
actions.pocketbase_run_sql.description: Runs a SQL query against the instance database.
actions.pocketbase_run_sql.props.query.d: SQLite SQL, e.g. "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY status".
actions.pocketbase_truncate_collection.d: Permanently deletes every record in a collection, keeping the collection.
actions.pocketbase_truncate_collection.p: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.pocketbase_update_collection.des: Renames a collection, adds fields, or changes its rules and options.
actions.pocketbase_update_collection.pro: Array of new field definitions to append, e.g. [{ "name": "summary", "type": "text" }]. Existing fields are kept.
Other collection options sent as-is, e.g. { "indexes": [...] }. A "fields" array here replaces the whole field list.
Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.
New collection name. Leave empty to keep the current name.
Object with any of listRule, viewRule, createRule, updateRule, deleteRule to change. A filter string limits access, "" allows everyone, null means superusers only.
New SQL SELECT for a view collection.
actions.pocketbase_update_settings.props: Partial settings object, e.g. { "batch": { "enabled": true, "maxRequests": 50, "timeout": 3 } } or { "logs": { "maxDays": 7 } }. Sections: meta, logs, backups, smtp, s3, batch, rateLimits, trustedProxy.
actions.pocketbase_upload_backup.descrip: Uploads a backup zip file to the instance.
actions.pocketbase_upload_backup.props.f: A PocketBase backup .zip file, e.g. one returned by Download Backup.
actions.updateRecord.description: Updates a single record in a collection
actions.updateRecord.props.collection.de: The name of the PocketBase collection
actions.updateRecord.props.fields.descri: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name
actions.updateRecord.props.recordData.de: JSON object with the fields to update. E.g.: { "title": "test", "score": 123 }
actions.updateRecord.props.recordId.desc: ID of the record to update

Provide your PocketBase **host URL** and **superuser credentials**.

Find your admin panel at `https://your-host/_/`.
auth.props.email.description: The email address of your Pocketbase superuser
auth.props.password.description: The password of your Pocketbase superuser
